Subject: RetailCo — post-demo recap + next steps (model fit + evals)

Hi Sarah — great to meet earlier, thanks for walking us through the RetailCo use cases. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

What we heard
- Primary goal: product-side summarization and intent extraction from customer chat logs (short-turn conversations, ~8–12 tokens typical).
- Current pain: on-prem model has variable extraction accuracy; latency target <= 120ms P95 and consistent output labels.
- Success metrics: intent F1 >= 0.88 on curated prompt set, and no regressions after model updates.

Redwood recommendations (initial)
- Model family: rdx-large-qa-v2 (quantized 8-bit) for a balance of latency and quality.
- Eval plan: we’ll run our evaluation harness on your shared prompt set and return per-prompt diffs + suggested prompt tweaks.
- Safety/ops: recommend pinning to model version v2.0 for baseline tests, then canary v2.1 in a subset of traffic.

Next steps
1) We’ll run a quick model-fit eval on your prompt set — ETA 48 hours. (David / Rafael to lead.)
2) Share benchmark links and detailed diffs back to you.
3) If you’re comfortable, set up a 10% canary for v2.1 with automatic rollback on quality regression.

Attachments
- I’ve attached a short eval checklist and a template for the prompt set mapping.

If this matches your expectations, I’ll schedule time for Rafael and Monica to review the eval results with your ML team next week.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

Marissa / team — quick update from the infra/serving side after running the harness on RetailCo's held-out set: 

Summary of findings
- Overall intent F1: v2.0 = 0.91, v2.1 = 0.82 on the held-out set (see attached CSV for per-prompt diffs).
- Tokenization changes: v2.1 introduced a whitespace normalization tweak causing altered token boundaries for several examples — explains most label shift.
- Regression pattern: short-turn intents with embedded punctuation showed highest drop.

Recommended immediate actions
1) Pin RetailCo account to rdx-large-qa-v2@v2.0 immediately (will force-serving to the prior model binary). ETA: 45 minutes once we have approval.
2) Create a 5% canary of v2.1 with instrumentation to auto-rollback if F1 drops > 0.03 vs baseline.
3) Provide a tokenization diff artifact and suggested prompt edits (we’ll attach a CSV and sample rewritten prompts).

Operational notes
- We cannot retroactively change previously served outputs, but we can pin and re-run batch reconciliation if RetailCo wants.
- Risk: pinning will keep them on v2.0 and delay access to v2.1 improvements; recommend a short scheduled canary + parallel evaluation.

Attachments: model_output_diffs_v2.0_vs_v2.1.csv (generated), tokenization_diff_notes.txt (stub)

Let me know to proceed with pin and rollback plan.
— Dev
